title: Sub-processor List
company: Silver Lady Holdings Ltd, trading as TMSWizzard

runs.text: This list names the third parties that process personal data for TMSWizzard. It forms part of our Data Processing Agreement. We give at least 30 days' notice of additions or replacements.
These providers process Customer Personal Data on our behalf when we act as your processor.

head: Provider
Purpose
Data involved

rows: Supabase
Database, authentication, file storage, sign-in and invitation emails
All customer data, including driver records, GPS positions and proof-of-delivery files
Hosted in the UK (London). Supabase is a US-headquartered company. Any access from outside the UK is covered by its data processing addendum with the UK Addendum or IDTA.
Vercel
Application hosting, serverless functions, scheduled tasks and server logs
All request traffic, IP addresses, and logs that may include postcodes and stop references
Functions run in the UK (London). Vercel is a US-headquartered company. UK Addendum or UK Extension to the EU-US Data Privacy Framework.

Microsoft 365 tenant data held in the UK or EEA. Microsoft Products and Services Data Protection Addendum.

Stop addresses and postcodes, coordinates of a day's route, approximate vehicle positions shown on a map, and the viewing user's IP address

runs.text: These are not our sub-processors. They act under your own agreement with the provider. We exchange data with them only when an administrator connects them.

head: Service
What is exchanged
rows: Xero

Customer name, account code and accounts email; invoice numbers, dates, references and line items. Requests and responses are logged in TMSWizzard for 12 months to support troubleshooting. Your Xero access tokens are stored encrypted.

A driver identifier is sent. Drivers' hours activity records are returned.

sections.heading: 4. Services your users may open from their browser

runs.text: These are opened in a new tab at the user's request. They receive information directly from the user's browser under their own terms.

head: Service
What is passed
rows: WhatsApp (Meta)
The contact's phone number and a proof-of-delivery link, when a user chooses to share by WhatsApp
Google Maps
The delivery address, when a driver chooses to open navigation

runs.text: TMSWizzard uses no analytics, advertising or artificial intelligence providers. Fonts are hosted by us and are not fetched from Google.
We will notify administrators of changes by email or in the product. To object to a change, email it@silverlady.group within 14 days of the notice, as described in the Data Processing Agreement.
